newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money traded at 11.0/12.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money traded at 11.0/12.0 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was traded at 11.0/12.0 percent on Wednesday morning, dealers said.
They said liquidity supply was sufficient despite a small injection from the central bank of some 166 billion rupiah.
One Japanese bank dealer said operators were looking to Thursday's liquidity when the share offering by PT Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) ends.
But dealers said operators were not worried because Bank Indonesia was seen to have bought some $500 million on Tuesday to support the dollar which would keep the market flushed on Thursday.
They said Bank Indonesia might have no problem in sterilising additional rupiah because BNI might place funds from the public offering into central bank papers (SBIs) temporarily.
Overnight swap was at 0.55/0.65 and tom/next at 0.35/0.45.
The average overnight interbank rate on Tuesday was 11.77 percent, compared with 11.53 percent on Monday.
